itineraryItems.description: Enjoy convenient pick-up service from select hotels along the Las Vegas Strip, ensuring a hassle-free start to your Grand Canyon adventure. Pick-up time is approximately 6:20am, allowing you to maximize your day exploring the Grand Canyon. Enjoy seamless transportation and exceptional service from start to finish.
Travel through the ancient Joshua Tree Forest en route to the West Rim of the Grand Canyon.

Spend 3.5 hours discovering the stunning Grand Canyon's West Rim, a unique destination that is home to the Hualapai Indian Tribe. Your visit includes time at Eagle Point (30 minutes to 1 hour), Guano Point (30 minutes to 1 hour), and the option to experience the thrilling Skywalk (30 minutes to 1 hour). For an even more unforgettable adventure, you can add a helicopter and Pontoon boat tour(20~30 mins) or west rim airplane flight tour for optional upgrade(~20 mins). Enjoy lunch (if option selected) and take in the breathtaking views throughout your visit.

Located at the western end of the Colorado Canyon, the West Rim is just a three-hour drive from Las Vegas. The Skywalk, a U-shaped glass bridge, offers an exhilarating experience of the canyon's vastness and beauty.

Step onto the Grand Canyon West Skywalk for breathtaking, unparalleled views of one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World. This 10-foot-wide, horseshoe-shaped glass bridge extends 70 feet beyond the canyon's edge, offering a thrilling clear view 4,000 feet down to the canyon floor. There's no adventure quite like the Skywalk, where you can walk on glass high above the Grand Canyon and experience its vastness from a whole new perspective.

Head to Eagle Point, the iconic home of the Grand Canyon Skywalk, for spectacular views of the West Rim. This stunning lookout offers breathtaking vistas of the Grand Canyon, and if you look closely, you can spot the eagle-shaped rock formation that gives Eagle Point its name. Don't miss the chance to experience one of the most famous viewing points at the Grand Canyon West.

Experience even more spectacular views at Guano Point, one of the best vantage points over the Colorado River at Grand Canyon West. Take a hike to the highest point for panoramic scenery, offering majestic views of the Colorado River and the canyon's vastness. If you prefer a more relaxed visit, simply unwind and soak in the tranquility of this stunning natural wonder.

On your return journey to Las Vegas, enjoy a scenic stop at the Hoover Dam Memorial Bridge for a photo opportunity. Capture stunning images of the iconic Hoover Dam before continuing your comfortable bus ride back to the Las Vegas Strip.
